S01.setting: state bedchamber at Versailles (Salon de Mercure was the king's ceremonial bedchamber 1682-1701), c. 1685: gilded panelling, painted ceiling, canopied bed, tall windows and candles
S01.wardrobe: king: embroidered night robe then court dress; court: period dress only
S01.light: warm candle key, cool window fill, no modern light sources
S01.weather: not specified; soft daylight through tall windows
S01.shot_axis: camera POV from the page standing at the foot of the bed, king screen-left, doors screen-right
S01.sound_bed: murmur, wax candles, parquet footsteps, fabric, door latches, own low harpsichord bed

S02.setting: threshold of the Grande Galerie / Hall of Mirrors (built 1678-1684), arched windows one side, mirror panels the other
S02.wardrobe: king in embroidered court coat and full curled wig; courtiers in period dress
S02.light: daylight from arched windows, no modern light sources
S02.shot_axis: camera ahead of the king, walking backwards; king facing the lens
S02.sound_bed: footsteps on parquet, murmur, distant door, own harpsichord sting

S03.setting: wig table beside the canopied bed: three wigs on wooden stands, powder puff, hand mirror, candle and window light
S03.wardrobe: king in gold silk dressing gown over a lace nightshirt, dark curled wig then white-grey wig as a gag
S03.light: window and candle, no modern light
S03.shot_axis: camera at table height, king in profile at the top of the frame, valet hand entering lower right
S03.sound_bed: wig stand creak, powder puff, small cough, murmur
